title: I'm a long time MacBook user and tried Microsoft's new Surface Book 2 for a week - here's what I learned (MSFT, AAPL, GOOG)
text: I'm a long time MacBook user and tried Microsoft's new Surface Book 2 for a week — here's what I learned (MSFT, AAPL, GOOG) By Edoardo Maggio Jan 23, 2018, 6:14 am 27 pts I have used a MacBook Pro as my main computing machine for the past five years, and switched to Microsoft's new Surface Book 2 for a week to see how the transition was.
